opus.problem: This clue gives the word away on its own. 'Horses of fire' separating Elijah from Elisha points straight to the famous 'chariot of fire', which is also an accepted answer, so the clue is not medium hard.

The detail that Ahab died propped up in his chariot is not in 1 Kings 22:38. It comes from 1 Kings 22:35. The cited verse only says the chariot was washed at the pool of Samaria and the dogs licked up Ahab's blood.
